summary: The girl group gives EYEKONS a front-row seat to the highs, challenges and breakthrough moments behind its success.

From Dream Academy contestants to Billboard chart-toppers, KATSEYE has had quite the glow-up. But as any EYEKON knows, the group’s road to global pop domination didn’t happen overnight. Now, fans are getting a backstage pass to the highs, lows and everything in between.

Inside KATSEYE’s New WILD HEARTS Documentary : Summary

KATSEYE might make global pop stardom look effortless, but WILD HEARTS tells a different story.

Directed by Nadia Hallgren and produced by Interscope Films and Boardwalk Pictures in partnership with HYBE x Geffen, the documentary pulls back the curtain on the group’s rise, from the competitive environment of Dream Academy to the pressures of building an international music career.

Alongside never-before-seen footage and candid interviews, the film gives EYEKONS their own moment in the spotlight through fan-submitted videos.

The release also comes on the heels of KATSEYE’s third EP, WILD , which debuted atop the Billboard 200 , and the launch of its WILDWORLD Tour. For fans who have followed the group since day one, consider this a look at just how far they’ve come.
